entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: Privremena nedostupnost planinarskih putova na Dinari u mjesecu lipnju 2026.
entries.note_en: Temporary unavailability of hiking trails on Dinara during June 2026.

entries.note_hr: U NP Risnjak od 26. lipnja 2026. zatvara se planinarski ulaz Vilje te planinarska staza Vilje - Risnjak (dio staze 108).
entries.note_en: In NP Risnjak, the Vilje mountain entrance and the Vilje - Risnjak trail (part of trail 108) are closed from 26 June 2026.

entries.note_hr: Lokalno su mogući izraženiji pljuskovi praćeni grmljavinom i prolazno jakim, na udare i olujnim vjetrom. Moguća je obilnija oborina u kratkom vremenskom razdoblju, osobito u Lici. Najjači udari vjetra > 55 km/h; Količina oborine 30-60 mm; Vjerojatnost grmljavine > 60 %.
entries.note_en: Locally intense showers with thunder and temporarily strong to stormy wind gusts are possible. Heavy rainfall in a short period is possible, especially in Lika. Peak gusts > 55 km/h; rainfall 30-60 mm; probability of thunderstorms > 60%.
entries.gear: Rain jacket; avoid exposed ridgeline and high ground especially between 12:00 and 20:00

entries.note_hr: Toplinski val. Maksimalna temperatura > 33 °C; Minimalna temperatura > 16 °C. Budite spremni na pojavu zdravstvenog rizika zbog vrućine i visokih temperatura kod osjetljive populacije.
entries.note_en: Heat wave. Maximum temperature > 33°C; minimum temperature > 16°C. Be prepared for health risks due to heat and high temperatures, especially among vulnerable individuals.
entries.gear: Sunscreen, minimum 2 L water per person, electrolytes; avoid hiking midday on exposed terrain

entries.note_hr: Pojačana, mjestimice jaka bura na Velebitskom kanalu. Najjači udari vjetra 35-45 čvorova (65-85 km/h). Očekuju se lokalno opasne brzine vjetra koje uzrokuju valove rizične za manja plovila.
entries.note_en: Strong and locally very strong bora wind in the Velebit channel. Peak gusts 35-45 knots (65-85 km/h). Locally dangerous wind speeds expected, creating waves hazardous to smaller vessels.
entries.gear: Windproof layer; extra caution on exposed western Velebit sections; no sea crossings with small craft

entries.note_hr: Toplinski val u Riječkoj regiji. Maksimalna temperatura > 37 °C; Minimalna temperatura > 26 °C. Stupanj pripravnosti: Crveno.
entries.note_en: Heat wave in the Rijeka region (Kvarner / Gorski kotar / Učka / Risnjak). Maximum temperature > 37°C; minimum temperature > 26°C. Readiness level: Red.
entries.gear: Sunscreen, minimum 2 L water per person, electrolytes; avoid hiking midday on exposed terrain; plan hut stops for shade

entries.note_hr: Planinarski dom Alan od 19. rujna 2025. ponovno pruža mogućnost noćenja. Kuća i dalje nudi usluge prehrane (po dogovoru) kao i ponudu pića, napitaka i opskrbu vodom.
entries.note_en: Planinarski dom Alan has resumed overnight accommodation from 19 September 2025. The hut continues to offer meals (by arrangement) as well as drinks, beverages and water supply.
